import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv')

cur = c.set_index('instance_type')
u['family'] = u['instance_type'].map(cur['family'])
u['req_vcpu'] = u.apply(lambda r: cur.loc[r.instance_type,'vcpu']*r.p95_cpu_pct/100/0.7, axis=1)
u['req_mem'] = u.apply(lambda r: cur.loc[r.instance_type,'memory_gib']*r.p95_mem_pct/100/0.8, axis=1)
u['cur_cost'] = u.instance_type.map(cur['hourly_usd'])

res=[]
for _,r in u.iterrows():
    fam = c[(c.family==r.family)&(c.vcpu>=r.req_vcpu)&(c.memory_gib>=r.req_mem)]
    if len(fam)==0:
        rec = r.instance_type
    else:
        rec = fam.sort_values('hourly_usd').iloc[0].instance_type
    u.at[r.name,'rec']=rec
u['rec_cost'] = u.rec.map(cur['hourly_usd'])
under = u[u.rec_cost > u.cur_cost + 1e-12]
print(under[['instance_id','instance_type','rec','cur_cost','rec_cost']])
print(sorted(under.instance_id.tolist()))

u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv')
cur = c.set_index('instance_type')
for i in [16,17]:
    r = u.iloc[i]
    v = cur.loc[r.instance_type,'vcpu']; m = cur.loc[r.instance_type,'memory_gib']
    rv = v*r.p95_cpu_pct/100/0.7; rm = m*r.p95_mem_pct/100/0.8
    print(r.instance_id, r.instance_type, 'req_vcpu=%.3f'%rv, 'req_mem=%.3f'%rm)
    fam = c[(c.family==cur.loc[r.instance_type,'family'])&(c.vcpu>=rv)&(c.memory_gib>=rm)]
    print(fam[['instance_type','vcpu','memory_gib','hourly_usd']].to_string())
